# dim_training_tracks

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_training_tracks` · dbt area: `training`

Dimension table for training tracks advisors are offered in Portal. Each row represents a single track with metadata (name, description, estimated completion time) and computed lesson/module counts. Training tracks can include multiple training modules. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `training_track_id` | Primary Key. Unique identifier for each training track. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `archived_at` | When the track was archived. NULL if the module has not been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `created_at` | When the track was created. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_current_lessons_in_track` | Current count of lessons (non-archived) within the track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_current_modules_in_track` | Current count of modules (non-archived) within the track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_archived` | True if the track has been archived. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_complete_time_minutes` | The estimated total time to complete the track (in minutes), as displayed to advisors. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_description` | Description of the track and its content. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `track_name` | Display name of the track. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `updated_at` | When the track was last updated. >> SOURCE - Portal |
